verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is delivered as a programmatic API compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic formats, so it can be driven non-interactively from scripts and pipelines through standard SDKs. Automation is backed by structured JSON output, documented function calling, streaming, and documented concurrency limits and 429 handling, and it can serve as the backend model for agent tools like Claude Code and OpenCode. missing for 10: an explicit CI/headless integration guide or official CLI, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
